import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_70/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length1_70/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Perform the join on 'order_id'
merged = pd.merge(
    df0[['order_id', 'order_status', 'order_approved_at']],
    df1[['order_id', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price', 'freight_value']],
    on='order_id',
    how='inner'
)

# Ensure column types match target schema
merged['order_id'] = merged['order_id'].astype(str)
merged['order_status'] = merged['order_status'].astype(str)
merged['order_approved_at'] = merged['order_approved_at'].astype(str)
merged['product_id'] = merged['product_id'].astype(str)
merged['seller_id'] = merged['seller_id'].astype(str)
merged['price'] = merged['price'].astype(float)
merged['freight_value'] = merged['freight_value'].astype(float)

# Reorder columns to match target schema
target_columns = ['order_id', 'order_status', 'order_approved_at', 'product_id', 'seller_id', 'price', 'freight_value']
Target1_70 = merged[target_columns]

# Write the result to the specified path without the index
Target1_70.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join on order_id (inner join by default)
result = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="order_id", how="inner")

# Select only the columns in the target schema and keep their order
result = result[[
    "order_id",
    "order_status",
    "order_approved_at",
    "product_id",
    "seller_id",
    "price",
    "freight_value"
]]

# Write the final output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_70/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
